nodes.name: Receive Lead
nodes.notes: Point Zapier's LinkedIn Lead Gen Forms trigger at this URL via a Webhooks by Zapier action. Zapier already holds LinkedIn's API approval, so you don't need your own. This same node also works for LinkedIn Lead Sync directly if you ever get approved — it responds immediately, which satisfies LinkedIn's 3-second requirement.

nodes.name: Has Contact Details?
nodes.notes: The CRM rejects leads with no email and no phone. Catching it here keeps the run log clean and lets you route the rejects somewhere useful.

nodes.name: Send to CRM
nodes.notes: The Authorization header carries the project publishable key, which is public by design — it only satisfies the Supabase gateway. Real authentication is the x-api-key.
